caption: The drawing features two carved wooden utensils lying horizontally on a plain, light beige background. The object on the upper side is a spoon with a shallow, rounded bowl and a long, straight handle. The bowl of the spoon is divided into three lobes by incised lines, while the handle is lightly textured with diagonal grooves, and both the handle and bowl are shaded in various tones of tan and brown, indicating a wood material and grain. The lower object resembles a pestle or club, with a bulbous, segmented head and a straight handle. The handle has two ring-like grooves carved near the top and tapers slightly toward the end. Like the spoon, it is colored with shades of brown and grayish-beige, showing wood grain and some shadowing for dimensional effect. Both objects are depicted with attention to texture and form, spaced apart horizontally against the background.
title: Carved Wooden Spoon
